description.p: Mari is an app for writing.
It is minimalist yet powerful, and all of it is aimed at one thing: making the best text possible.

Mark a paragraph the way you would on a printed page — good, weak, cut, come back to this. Open a rewrite beside the original and work on both at once. What you cut goes to the drawer instead of nowhere, and comes back whenever you want it. Notes, old versions, the plan and a map of the whole piece are all there, and all of it lives in one file you can send to somebody, who opens exactly what you see.

Free, and the source is open
